broad_dollar_dataset.provider: FRED (Federal Reserve Board H.10 via FRED)
broad_dollar_dataset.release_cadence: Daily; FRB trade-weighted indexes typically available with about one business-day lag.

point_in_time_safety.alignment: Daily Broad USD levels as-of joined to Friday NG weeks (last observation on or before week date). Transforms use only past weekly as-of levels — no full-sample z-score.

broad_dollar_dataset.revisions_policy: FRB/FRED index levels; occasional restatements possible but material delayed-revision risk is low versus EIA physical series. Research treats the downloaded daily values as point-in-time as-of.

alignment_with_ng_history.note: Daily Broad USD covers the post-2016 NG weekly valuation panel. Safe to align with storage + production YoY history via as-of join.

broad_dollar_dataset.economic_rationale: A stronger Broad USD typically pressures commodity prices, so the coefficient on log(NG price) should be negative.
